row.notes: Race-start (anti-stall / launch) system singleton. Components register into its vector +0x48..+0x50 (cap +0x58, allocator +0x40) in 0x142f491f0. Per-car update 0x142f4a070 reads +0x100 (system armed) and +0x108 (start released): while not armed it sets the car's start-lock bit 1 (car+0x1fc |= 2), clears +0x21c, flags the input record (+0x1c |= 0x20) and, for controller type 11, writes launch mode 1 (or 2 once count +0x104 >= limit +0xb8) to [car+0x538]+0x680; when armed it clears bit 1 again. +0xc4 copied to each car entry +0x20. Siblings at 0x146095a80 (session clock) / 0x146095a88 (pit lane). (used by vmknolle race-start: release the start lock after grid restarts)
